name: Úlairë Enquëa
subtitle: Lieutenant of Morgul
game_text:
<keyword>Fierce</keyword>.
<phase>Maneuver</phase>: Spot 6 companions (or 5 burdens) and exert Úlairë Enquëa to wound a companion (except the Ring-bearer).
